summary: Independent review of PR #177 found workflow_dispatch can publish a non-main ref.
validation: Validation-only gate split and artifact-only publication conditions are otherwise correct.
blockers: workflow_dispatch unconditionally sets image_changed=true and chart_changed=true without restricting the selected ref to refs/heads/main.
A non-main manual dispatch could publish branch artifacts and bump deployment metadata.
next_action: Add a fail-closed main-ref guard and regression test, rerun exact-head review and QA, then merge normally.
